test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Successive discounts of 33% and 30% are equivalent to what single discount?
solution:
Given:

Approximate single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of 33%, and 30%

Formula Used:

Single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of a % and b %

= (a + b - (ab)/(100))%

Calculation:

Here, a = 33% , and b = 30 %

So, the single discount gets, (33 + 30 - 30 × 33/100) %

⇒ (63 - 9.9) %

⇒ 53.1 %

The approximate single discount is 53.1%
